bluesky.text:
For me, context is the real bottleneck — not prompting or tools.

AI is a processor more than a thinker, and without clear, structured context, even the best model gives inconsistent results.

The judgment still has to come from us.

Can you imagine a day when websites are no longer needed?

Today, the visitor brings their own LLM. I’m not talking about GEO, making old websites visible to AI. I’m talking about sites written for the visitor’s LLM to read.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-357577987

Own your business and your creative process first. Depending on a platform is a high-risk strategy. Build something real — offline, grounded, yours — and let the digital version grow from that foundation.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-269753391

Why are my team members holding on to information about their jobs?

I believe they are confusing information and skill. The information belongs to the company, but their skill is irreplaceable and unique to each one of them.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-319364598

AI productivity is moving from the IT department to every desk.

The companies gaining ground aren’t the ones with the fanciest enterprise AI tools. They’re the ones where individual team members can automate their own workflows - safely, without disrupting existing processes.
